# Zapier CEO Copilot: Shareable Skills

> Three agent skills Wade Foster (Co-Founder & CEO, Zapier) demoed at Running Remote 2026, cleaned up into general-purpose, tool-agnostic Markdown skill files you can drop into Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Projects, or any chatbot.

## Skills

- [War Council](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/skills/war-council/SKILL.md): Convenes a panel of opinionated expert personas to stress-test a decision and return a ranked, bet-weighted recommendation.
- [Meeting Follow-Up Pipeline](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/skills/meeting-follow-up-pipeline/SKILL.md): Turns a finished meeting into a debrief, decisions, action items, ready-to-send follow-up drafts, and proposed writebacks.
- [Exec Weekly Agenda Generator](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/skills/exec-weekly-agenda-generator/SKILL.md): Sweeps the week across meetings, chat, email, and calendar into a forced-ranked list of topics for a leadership meeting.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/README.md): what this repo is, the three skills, and how to install them.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install and usage guidance for AI agents.
- [Claude Code plugin manifest](https://github.com/zapier/wade-skills/blob/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): install via `/plugin install wade-skills@zapier` once added to `zapier/marketplace`.
